انتحبوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَبُوا (intaḥabū) /in.ta.ħa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# اِنْتَحِبُوا (intaḥibū) /in.ta.ħi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
